notes.title: Join the community, follow & help development! 👾
notes.content:
Hello, Pioneers!

I'd like to invite you to the new [i]kóborfotonok games[/i] [b]Discord[/b] server! 🎉

It's fresh and quiet now, but my goal is to grow it into a vibrant community over time. Whether you're a casual spectator or eager to get involved in the development of my games, this is the best way to connect! 🙌

💡 share your thoughts
📺 see exclusive content
🙋‍♂️ ask questions
🎮 meet fellow adventurers
💪 show off your skills
🎲 discuss design issues
💭 help the development
🐞 report bugs
🕹️ participate in playtests

[url=https://discord.com/invite/8PEvMymUZk]See you there![/url] 👾

Please let me also recommend three of my Instagram profiles for you to check out:
[url=https://www.instagram.com/koborfotonok/ ]@koborfotonok[/url] - my main profile with much more than game dev
[url=https://www.instagram.com/cosminomy/ ]@cosminomy[/url] - for Cosminomy
[url=https://www.instagram.com/thesaviorfromabove/ ]@thesaviorfromabove[/url] - for my first game The Savior From Above

Thank you for your support!
[i]K[/i]

notes.title: Full steam ahead! 🚀
notes.content:
I was thrilled to share Cosminomy's demo with you for the very first time, your feedback has been incredibly valuable during the past weeks! 🙏

I'm excited to continue with the development, full steam ahead. I’ll be back soon with details about the next milestone. 👽

In the meantime, the demo will remain available until [b]Sunday[/b] (Nov 10), so if you haven’t had the chance to dive in yet, now’s the perfect time! 🚀

Thank you for your support!
[i]K[/i]

notes.title: Cosminomy Demo is Now Available! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello,
Here I am with another milestone!

Thanks to Steam's Next Fest, Cosminomy's demo version is now available, but only for a limited time.
Now is the perfect time to try the game! 🚀

This demo version features 4 planets and 7 facilities with ~25min of playtime!

Have fun playing it and share it with some friends! 👽
[i]K[/i]
